Hi Connor,

We are running MedicaSys's SOC 2 readiness review and need a timeboxed export of operator/admin activity for a sampling window. Can you confirm what you can provide for the following items?

- Scope: operator/admin actions (console/API) for the period 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-27.
- Fields: timestamp (UTC), actor_id, actor_type (user/service), action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id/trace_id, requester_ip, region, outcome (success/fail), kv-cache-miss/hit indicators where available.
- Retention note: current retention in prod and snapshot options for longer-term retention.
- Export formats: NDJSON / CSV / Parquet; gzip permissible.
- Delivery: secure presigned S3 link OR SFTP transfer; we require chain-of-custody manifest and checksums (sha256) and a signed assertion from your security team.
- Redaction: any PII minimization steps you apply (we prefer minimally redacted with clear redaction markers).

Deadline: target is 2026-12-06 for delivery of the sample package and manifest.

Please advise on lead time and any PO/DPA or data access approvals needed.

Thanks,
MedicaSys Audit Team

Hi MedicaSys audit team / Lynne,

Thanks for the clear scope. We can produce a timebound operator trail covering that window. High-level options: 

1) Signed snapshot (NDJSON gzipped) delivered via a presigned S3 object (recommended). We will include: export_manifest.json, SHA256 checksums, and a chain_of_custody-signed.txt from our security lead. Files are encrypted at rest with SSE-KMS. Transfer link will expire; we can provide a one-week window or a shorter window per your preference.

2) SFTP push to a customer-owned host (requires coordination and network allowlisting).

3) Secure physical media is not viable for this case (small dataset).

Retention & sampling: our default admin/activity retention for production is 12 months in the hot ledger, then 24 months in cold storage snapshots for enterprise customers. For this request we can produce the requested window and, if you need a longer preserved copy, we can perform a signed archive with an extended retention flag (requires an internal approval note and an export SLA).

We will redact any direct PII at the field level (email addresses will be hashed with HMAC-SHA256; we can provide original values under additional NDA/PSA if medically necessary).

I will loop in our security and export team to prepare the sample and manifest. Question: do you require the full request_id->trace_id mapping or just the request_id? We can include trace_id where available.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Engineer, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
